name: Shaymin
flavour_text: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Weedle
flavour_text: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
flavour_text: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Pinsir
flavour_text: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Sprigatito
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floragato
flavour_text: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Meowscarada
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

name: Magmar
flavour_text: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Magmortar
flavour_text: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavour_text: When heated by fire energy, its horns can get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Those gored by them will suffer both wounds and burns.

name: Tentacool
flavour_text: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.

name: Tentacruel
flavour_text: When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

name: Buizel
flavour_text: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

name: Floatzel
flavour_text: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Wiglett
flavour_text: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Dondozo
flavour_text: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

name: Tatsugiri
flavour_text: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

name: Voltorb
flavour_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavour_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Pachirisu
flavour_text: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

name: Pawmi
flavour_text: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavour_text: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot
flavour_text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Abra
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

name: Kadabra
flavour_text: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

name: Alakazam
flavour_text: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Mr. Mime
flavour_text: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Drifloon
flavour_text: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Drifblim
flavour_text: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

name: Gimmighoul
flavour_text: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: Machop
flavour_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavour_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Hitmonlee
flavour_text: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

name: Hitmonchan
flavour_text: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

name: Riolu
flavour_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Flamigo
flavour_text: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Ekans
flavour_text: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok
flavour_text: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavour_text: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Spiritomb
flavour_text: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Shroodle
flavour_text: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: Grafaiai
flavour_text: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

name: Tinkatink
flavour_text: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Tinkatuff
flavour_text: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: Varoom
flavour_text: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Revavroom
flavour_text: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

name: Gholdengo
flavour_text: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

name: Rattata
flavour_text: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

name: Raticate
flavour_text: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you’ll become sleepy right away.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Lickitung
flavour_text: If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won’t go away, either.

name: Lickilicky
flavour_text: Lickilicky’s strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky’s tongue can stretch so far.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavour_text: Blazing sunlight has brought out the true form and powers of this Pokémon.

name: Surskit
flavour_text: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

name: Masquerain
flavour_text: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

name: Maractus
flavour_text: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

name: Karrablast
flavour_text: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Phantump
flavour_text: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit’s rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Trevenant
flavour_text: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.

name: Rowlet
flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Rowlet

name: Dartrix
flavour_text: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don’t groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

name: Grubbin
flavour_text: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

name: Fomantis
flavour_text: Fomantis hates having its naps interrupted. It fires off beams using energy it gathers by bathing in the sun.

name: Lurantis
flavour_text: By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down.

name: Morelull
flavour_text: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull’s head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Shiinotic
flavour_text: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Bounsweet
flavour_text: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavour_text: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
flavour_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Wimpod
flavour_text: It’s nature’s cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavour_text: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Tapu Bulu
flavour_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, it’s violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavour_text: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavour_text: This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and dances through the night as a way to mourn its fallen allies.

name: Fletchinder
flavour_text: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

name: Talonflame
flavour_text: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs.

name: Litten
flavour_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Litten
flavour_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
flavour_text: Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they’ve grown close, but it’s a powerful, sharp-clawed Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

name: Salandit
flavour_text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
flavour_text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Turtonator
flavour_text: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavour_text: Life on mountains covered with deep snow has granted this Pokémon a body of ice that’s as hard as steel.

name: Alolan Sandslash
flavour_text: It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this Sandslash is faster than any other Pokémon.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavour_text: After long years in the ever-snowcapped mountains of Alola, this Vulpix has gained power over ice.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavour_text: A deity resides in the snowy mountains where this Pokémon lives. In ancient times, it was worshiped as that deity’s incarnation.

name: Shellder
flavour_text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
flavour_text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Lapras
flavour_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Popplio
flavour_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Popplio
flavour_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavour_text: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn’t know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Primarina
flavour_text: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.

name: Wishiwashi
flavour_text: Individually, they’re incredibly weak. It’s by gathering up into schools that they’re able to confront opponents.

name: Dewpider
flavour_text: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

name: Araquanid
flavour_text: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Pyukumuku
flavour_text: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Bruxish
flavour_text: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

name: Tapu Fini
flavour_text: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavour_text: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavour_text: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the “fireworks of the earth.”

name: Alolan Golem
flavour_text: It’s grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

name: Helioptile
flavour_text: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon’s electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Charjabug
flavour_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
flavour_text: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

name: Togedemaru
flavour_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Tapu Koko
flavour_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Mr. Mime
flavour_text: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Sableye
flavour_text: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Spoink
flavour_text: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

name: Grumpig
flavour_text: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Lunatone
flavour_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It’s active on the night of a full moon.

name: Shuppet
flavour_text: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

name: Banette
flavour_text: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. It uses ethereal dance steps to call forth the spirits of the dead.

name: Cutiefly
flavour_text: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.

name: Ribombee
flavour_text: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs’ effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

name: Comfey
flavour_text: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won’t wither once they’re attached to a Comfey.

name: Sandygast
flavour_text: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else—like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Palossand
flavour_text: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

name: Mimikyu
flavour_text: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Tapu Lele
flavour_text: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

name: Cosmog
flavour_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn’t seem to care.

name: Cosmoem
flavour_text: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the “cocoon of the stars” and built an altar to worship it.

name: Necrozma
flavour_text: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It’s apparently from another world.

name: Cubone
flavour_text: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Makuhita
flavour_text: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

name: Hariyama
flavour_text: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Solrock
flavour_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Drilbur
flavour_text: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

name: Timburr
flavour_text: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

name: Gurdurr
flavour_text: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

name: Conkeldurr
flavour_text: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

name: Crabrawler
flavour_text: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Lycanroc
flavour_text: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

name: Lycanroc
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

name: Mudbray
flavour_text: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won’t dry out even if it’s exposed to the sun for a long time.

name: Mudsdale
flavour_text: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

name: Minior
flavour_text: Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.

name: Alolan Rattata
flavour_text: It shows no interest in anything that isn’t fresh. If you take it shopping with you, it will help you pick out ingredients.

name: Alolan Raticate
flavour_text: It has an incredibly greedy personality. Its nest is filled with so much food gathered by Rattata at its direction, it can’t possibly eat it all.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavour_text: It’s accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it’s very picky about food.

name: Alolan Persian
flavour_text: The round face of Alolan Persian is considered to be a symbol of prosperity in the Alola region, so these Pokémon are very well cared for.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavour_text: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola’s waste-disposal site. They’re all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

name: Absol
flavour_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Trubbish
flavour_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavour_text: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Mareanie
flavour_text: This Pokémon wanders the seaside looking for food. It often gets electric shocks from broken Pincurchin spines that it tries to eat.

name: Toxapex
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives within a dome made by its own legs. Toxapex monitors its surroundings by sensing the flow of the tide through its spikes.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavour_text: The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon’s habitat caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavour_text: Their beautiful, metallic whiskers create a sort of protective helmet on their heads, and they also function as highly precise sensors.

name: Excadrill
flavour_text: It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill’s rampant digging.

name: Escavalier
flavour_text: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Klefki
flavour_text: Once it absorbs a key’s metal ions, it discards the key without a second thought. However, it will hang on to keys it favors for decades.

name: Magearna
flavour_text: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.

name: Drampa
flavour_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Jangmo-o
flavour_text: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

name: Hakamo-o
flavour_text: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.

name: Kommo-o
flavour_text: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.

name: Tauros
flavour_text: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

name: Skitty
flavour_text: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty
flavour_text: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Fletchling
flavour_text: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

name: Hawlucha
flavour_text: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

name: Pikipek
flavour_text: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

name: Trumbeak
flavour_text: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.

name: Toucannon
flavour_text: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

name: Yungoos
flavour_text: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

name: Gumshoos
flavour_text: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

name: Stufful
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
flavour_text: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Oranguru
flavour_text: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

name: Komala
flavour_text: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavour_text: Blazing sunlight has brought out the true form and powers of this Pokémon.

name: Morelull
flavour_text: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull’s head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Tsareena
flavour_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Tapu Bulu
flavour_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, it’s violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavour_text: This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and dances through the night as a way to mourn its fallen allies.

name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
flavour_text: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur
flavour_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Exeggcute
flavour_text: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor
flavour_text: Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
flavour_text: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Blastoise
flavour_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Staryu
flavour_text: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Starmie
flavour_text: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Gengar
flavour_text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

name: Machop
flavour_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavour_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Cubone
flavour_text: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Marowak
flavour_text: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you’ll become sleepy right away.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Petilil
flavour_text: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

name: Lilligant
flavour_text: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

name: Rowlet
flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavour_text: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don’t groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

name: Decidueye
flavour_text: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can’t afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

name: Pheromosa
flavour_text: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.

name: Kartana
flavour_text: This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Blacephalon
flavour_text: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Mantine
flavour_text: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

name: Carvanha
flavour_text: It won’t attack while it’s alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

name: Sharpedo
flavour_text: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

name: Shinx
flavour_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavour_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavour_text: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

name: Blitzle
flavour_text: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
flavour_text: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Emolga
flavour_text: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Xurkitree
flavour_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Zeraora
flavour_text: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavour_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Phantump
flavour_text: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
flavour_text: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.

name: Morelull
flavour_text: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Shiinotic
flavour_text: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Meditite
flavour_text: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

name: Medicham
flavour_text: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.

name: Baltoy
flavour_text: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
flavour_text: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Passimian
flavour_text: This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries. It won’t obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls without skill.

name: Sandygast
flavour_text: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else—like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Sandile
flavour_text: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok
flavour_text: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
flavour_text: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

name: Nihilego
flavour_text: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

name: Poipole
flavour_text: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Naganadel
flavour_text: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

name: Alolan Diglett

name: Aron
flavour_text: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
flavour_text: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Aggron
flavour_text: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

name: Ferroseed
flavour_text: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

name: Ferrothorn
flavour_text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Stakataka
flavour_text: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Lillipup
flavour_text: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

name: Herdier
flavour_text: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.

name: Stoutland
flavour_text: These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.

name: Stufful
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
flavour_text: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Oranguru
flavour_text: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

name: Type: Null
flavour_text: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Silvally
flavour_text: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

name: Celesteela
flavour_text: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.

name: Rowlet
flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Pheromosa
flavour_text: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.

name: Blacephalon
flavour_text: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavour_text: It’s accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it’s very picky about food.

name: Silvally
flavour_text: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

name: Celesteela
flavour_text: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavour_text: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

name: Froakie
flavour_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
flavour_text: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja
flavour_text: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Jynx
flavour_text: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Pidgey
flavour_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
flavour_text: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
flavour_text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Aerodactyl
flavour_text: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

name: Nihilego
flavour_text: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

name: Tropius
flavour_text: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Leafeon
flavour_text: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Bounsweet
flavour_text: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavour_text: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
flavour_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Applin
flavour_text: It grows by eating the flesh of an apple. Applin uses its own body fluid to strengthen the apple’s skin and prevent it from rotting.

name: Appletun
flavour_text: It feeds mainly on sweet apples. It will also eat small bug Pokémon that are attracted by its sweet nectar.

name: Flareon
flavour_text: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Torkoal
flavour_text: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Litten
flavour_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
flavour_text: Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they’ve grown close, but it’s a powerful, sharp-clawed Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

name: Incineroar
flavour_text: Although it’s rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

name: Salandit
flavour_text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
flavour_text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Vaporeon
flavour_text: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

name: Glaceon
flavour_text: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

name: Vanillite
flavour_text: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

name: Vanillish
flavour_text: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

name: Vanilluxe
flavour_text: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

name: Alomomola
flavour_text: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

name: Popplio
flavour_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavour_text: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn’t know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Jolteon
flavour_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Joltik
flavour_text: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’t produce a charge on its own.

name: Galvantula
flavour_text: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

name: Espeon
flavour_text: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.

name: Woobat
flavour_text: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s evidence that Woobat live there.

name: Swoobat
flavour_text: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a little while.

name: Swirlix
flavour_text: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn’t get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
flavour_text: By taking in a person’s scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It’s hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

name: Sylveon
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing their hostility.

name: Mimikyu
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Milcery
flavour_text: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
flavour_text: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.

name: Barboach
flavour_text: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.

name: Whiscash
flavour_text: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

name: Mienfoo
flavour_text: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

name: Mienshao
flavour_text: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

name: Carbink
flavour_text: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all out by firing high-energy beams from the gems embedded in its body.

name: Umbreon
flavour_text: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Sableye
flavour_text: Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.

name: Purrloin
flavour_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
flavour_text: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Togedemaru
flavour_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Meltan
flavour_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
flavour_text: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

name: Dratini
flavour_text: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Drampa
flavour_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Aipom
flavour_text: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavour_text: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that’s proof it really likes you.

name: Chatot
flavour_text: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.

name: Audino
flavour_text: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

name: Minccino
flavour_text: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Cinccino
flavour_text: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Skwovet
flavour_text: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

name: Greedent
flavour_text: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Leafeon
flavour_text: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Flareon
flavour_text: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Vaporeon
flavour_text: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

name: Glaceon
flavour_text: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

name: Jolteon
flavour_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Espeon
flavour_text: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.

name: Sylveon
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing their hostility.

name: Umbreon
flavour_text: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Pinsir
flavour_text: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Lapras
flavour_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Voltorb
flavour_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavour_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

name: Kirlia
flavour_text: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir
flavour_text: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Ekans
flavour_text: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok
flavour_text: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

name: Farfetch'd
flavour_text: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Oddish
flavour_text: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavour_text: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Bellossom
flavour_text: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Tangela
flavour_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Tangrowth
flavour_text: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

name: Scyther
flavour_text: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Pinsir
flavour_text: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Chikorita
flavour_text: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

name: Bayleef
flavour_text: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: Meganium
flavour_text: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

name: Ledyba
flavour_text: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
flavour_text: It’s said that the patterns on its back are related to the stars in the night sky, but the details of that relationship remain unclear.

name: Hoppip
flavour_text: Outside of cold regions, Hoppip can be found practically everywhere. This is because the wind carries this species all over the world.

name: Skiploom
flavour_text: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon’s head.

name: Jumpluff
flavour_text: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

name: Sunkern
flavour_text: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it’s weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.

name: Sunflora
flavour_text: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

name: Yanma
flavour_text: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Yanmega
flavour_text: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

name: Pineco
flavour_text: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

name: Heracross
flavour_text: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

name: Cherubi
flavour_text: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

name: Cherrim
flavour_text: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It’s full of energy while it’s like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

name: Vulpix
flavour_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavour_text: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Cyndaquil
flavour_text: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: Quilava
flavour_text: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

name: Typhlosion
flavour_text: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

name: Slugma
flavour_text: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
flavour_text: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Magby
flavour_text: This Pokémon is still small and timid. Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised, flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

name: Entei
flavour_text: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Darumaka
flavour_text: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

name: Darmanitan
flavour_text: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

name: Heatmor
flavour_text: There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Poliwag
flavour_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavour_text: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Politoed
flavour_text: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

name: Horsea
flavour_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra
flavour_text: It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

name: Magikarp
flavour_text: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados
flavour_text: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Totodile
flavour_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
flavour_text: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr
flavour_text: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Marill
flavour_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill
flavour_text: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Wooper
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
flavour_text: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Qwilfish
flavour_text: Be cautious if this Pokémon starts sucking in water—it will soon attack by scattering the toxic spikes that grow all over its body.

name: Corsola
flavour_text: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

name: Remoraid
flavour_text: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
flavour_text: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

name: Delibird
flavour_text: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

name: Mantine
flavour_text: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

name: Suicune
flavour_text: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Corphish
flavour_text: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Crawdaunt
flavour_text: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: Ducklett
flavour_text: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna
flavour_text: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Chinchou
flavour_text: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

name: Pichu
flavour_text: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

name: Mareep
flavour_text: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

name: Flaaffy
flavour_text: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

name: Ampharos
flavour_text: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

name: Elekid
flavour_text: When a storm approaches, this Pokémon gets restless. Once Elekid hears the sound of thunder, it gets full-on rowdy.

name: Raikou
flavour_text: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: Emolga
flavour_text: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowking
flavour_text: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Smoochum
flavour_text: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn’t really seem to care.

name: Jynx
flavour_text: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Cleffa
flavour_text: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.

name: Togepi
flavour_text: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
flavour_text: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss
flavour_text: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Natu
flavour_text: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

name: Xatu
flavour_text: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Unown
flavour_text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Unown
flavour_text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Wobbuffet
flavour_text: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

name: Girafarig
flavour_text: Girafarig’s tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.

name: Snubbull
flavour_text: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

name: Granbull
flavour_text: While it has powerful jaws, it doesn’t care for disputes, so it rarely has a chance to display their might.

name: Munna
flavour_text: Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.

name: Musharna
flavour_text: When dark mists emanate from its body, don’t get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.

name: Onix
flavour_text: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Sudowoodo
flavour_text: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

name: Gligar
flavour_text: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavour_text: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Swinub
flavour_text: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Piloswine
flavour_text: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Mamoswine
flavour_text: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

name: Phanpy
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Tyrogue
flavour_text: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Hitmontop
flavour_text: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Larvitar
flavour_text: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

name: Pupitar
flavour_text: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

name: Binacle
flavour_text: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

name: Barbaracle
flavour_text: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Zubat
flavour_text: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat
flavour_text: It loves to drink other creatures’ blood. It’s said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it’s gathered.

name: Spinarak
flavour_text: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

name: Ariados
flavour_text: Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.

name: Murkrow
flavour_text: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow

name: Sneasel

name: Weavile
flavour_text: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Houndour

name: Houndoom

name: Tyranitar
flavour_text: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn’t care about others.

flavour_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Forretress
flavour_text: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Steelix
flavour_text: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Scizor
flavour_text: This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Klink
flavour_text: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavour_text: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon’s rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavour_text: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Spearow
flavour_text: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

name: Fearow
flavour_text: Carrying food through Fearow’s territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Chansey
flavour_text: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Blissey
flavour_text: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

name: Kangaskhan
flavour_text: Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Porygon
flavour_text: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2

name: Porygon-Z
flavour_text: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.

name: Sentret

name: Furret

name: Hoothoot

name: Noctowl
