flavour_text: Although its wings have partly turned to steel and become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies through the skies with ease.

name: Goomy
flavour_text: Goomy’s horns are excellent sensory organs that cover all five of Goomy’s senses. Goomy picks up on danger from the movement of the air.

name: Delcatty
flavour_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Stoutland
flavour_text: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

name: Rufflet
flavour_text: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

name: Bellsprout
flavour_text: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
flavour_text: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel
flavour_text: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Rowlet
flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavour_text: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don’t groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

name: Moltres
flavour_text: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Litten
flavour_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
flavour_text: Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they’ve grown close, but it’s a powerful, sharp-clawed Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

name: Poliwag
flavour_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavour_text: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Poliwrath
flavour_text: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

name: Articuno
flavour_text: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Manaphy
flavour_text: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Popplio
flavour_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavour_text: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn’t know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Zapdos
flavour_text: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

name: Zeraora
flavour_text: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Drowzee
flavour_text: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.

name: Hypno
flavour_text: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

name: Geodude
flavour_text: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they’re totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

name: Graveler
flavour_text: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

name: Golem
flavour_text: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavour_text: The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon’s habitat caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

name: Meowth
flavour_text: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Persian
flavour_text: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Doduo
flavour_text: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Dodrio
flavour_text: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.

name: Bidoof
flavour_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Lilligant
flavour_text: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

name: Klefki
flavour_text: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Ivysaur
flavour_text: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

name: Venusaur
flavour_text: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Spinarak
flavour_text: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavour_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Sunkern
flavour_text: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

name: Sunflora
flavour_text: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.

name: Burmy
flavour_text: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

name: Mothim
flavour_text: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Charizard
flavour_text: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Houndour
flavour_text: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Houndoom
flavour_text: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
flavour_text: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Blastoise
flavour_text: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

name: Basculin
flavour_text: Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.

name: Clauncher
flavour_text: Clauncher’s claws will regrow if they fall off. The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a distinct flavor that doesn’t appeal to all tastes.

name: Clawitzer
flavour_text: The cannonballs of seawater that Clawitzer launches from its claw are powerful enough to punch through tanker hulls.

name: Magnemite
flavour_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavour_text: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Magnezone
flavour_text: Exposure to a special magnetic field changed Magneton’s molecular structure, turning it into Magnezone.

name: Emolga
flavour_text: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Helioptile
flavour_text: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Misdreavus
flavour_text: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Mismagius
flavour_text: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Solosis
flavour_text: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

name: Duosion
flavour_text: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Reuniclus
flavour_text: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Spritzee
flavour_text: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

name: Aromatisse
flavour_text: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

name: Xerneas
flavour_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Onix
flavour_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Makuhita
flavour_text: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama
flavour_text: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Nosepass
flavour_text: The magnet in Nosepass’s nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

name: Mienfoo
flavour_text: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

name: Mienshao
flavour_text: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Grimer
flavour_text: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: Muk
flavour_text: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.

name: Purrloin
flavour_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
flavour_text: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Trubbish
flavour_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavour_text: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Steelix
flavour_text: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Probopass
flavour_text: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

name: Genesect
flavour_text: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Ditto
flavour_text: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.

name: Porygon
flavour_text: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2
flavour_text: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

name: Porygon-Z
flavour_text: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.

name: Starly
flavour_text: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Staravia
flavour_text: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

name: Staraptor
flavour_text: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Lopunny
flavour_text: Once hot seasons are over, Lopunny’s coat will be replaced with fur that holds a lot of insulating air in preparation for colder weather.

name: Bouffalant
flavour_text: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

name: Furfrou
flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Ariados
flavour_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Sunflora
flavour_text: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.

name: Reuniclus
flavour_text: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Xerneas
flavour_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Trubbish
flavour_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Oddish
flavour_text: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavour_text: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Vileplume
flavour_text: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Charizard
flavour_text: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Shellder
flavour_text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
flavour_text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Sandshrew
flavour_text: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandslash
flavour_text: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Type: Null
flavour_text: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Silvally
flavour_text: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

name: Aegislash
flavour_text: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

name: Ledyba
flavour_text: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
flavour_text: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

name: Shuckle
flavour_text: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Roselia
flavour_text: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.

name: Roserade
flavour_text: The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.

name: Cacnea
flavour_text: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

name: Cacturne
flavour_text: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.

name: Chespin
flavour_text: Eating lots of berries makes the bark shell that covers Chespin’s head and body grow sturdier.

name: Quilladin
flavour_text: It can send a trailer flying with a tackle. It’s numb to pain, so even violent collisions don’t faze it.

name: Chesnaught
flavour_text: Its gentle disposition would have it avoid conflict, but it gives opponents a thrashing with its thorned fists when the situation calls for it.

name: Scatterbug
flavour_text: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.

name: Spewpa
flavour_text: Spewpa doesn’t live in a fixed location. It roams where it pleases across the fields and mountains, building up the energy it needs to evolve.

name: Vivillon
flavour_text: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

name: Buzzwole
flavour_text: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Gossifleur
flavour_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
flavour_text: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavour_text: The cursed flames that light up the bone carried by this Pokémon are said to cause both mental and physical pain that will never fade.

name: Reshiram
flavour_text: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.

name: Litleo
flavour_text: The more a Litleo trains its body and spirit by battling mighty enemies, the hotter its mane will grow.

name: Pyroar
flavour_text: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It’s thanks to them that their pride doesn’t starve.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

name: Scorbunny
flavour_text: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Raboot
flavour_text: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.

name: Cinderace
flavour_text: Using a ball that it made out of flames, Cinderace blinds its opponents and keeps them at bay.

name: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon
flavour_text: In this form, it draws on the power of fire. It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavour_text: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavour_text: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It’ll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
flavour_text: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Delibird
flavour_text: It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.

name: Mudkip
flavour_text: When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its small size.

name: Marshtomp
flavour_text: It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents that are bogged down and unable to move.

name: Swampert
flavour_text: Swampert’s arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down Swampert’s foes. This Pokémon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

name: Vanillite
flavour_text: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanillish
flavour_text: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanilluxe
flavour_text: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Cryogonal
flavour_text: Cryogonal uses its chains of ice to constrict its opponents and then flash-freezes them where they stand.

name: Amaura
flavour_text: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

name: Aurorus
flavour_text: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

name: Chewtle
flavour_text: A popular game among children is to lift up sticks that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose Chewtle can hang on the longest.

name: Drednaw
flavour_text: Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck out and chomps down on them.

name: Cramorant
flavour_text: Cramorant takes advantage of Arrokuda’s frantic thrashing to help spit Arrokuda out at high speed.

name: Arrokuda
flavour_text: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Barraskewda
flavour_text: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon
flavour_text: In this form, it draws on the power of water. It attacks unrelentingly with kicks and ivy strikes.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Alolan Raichu
flavour_text: This Pokémon rides on its tail while it uses its psychic powers to levitate. It attacks with star-shaped thunderbolts.

name: Zapdos
flavour_text: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

name: Plusle
flavour_text: This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its body to create noises.

name: Minun
flavour_text: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

name: Toxel
flavour_text: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Tadbulb
flavour_text: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

name: Bellibolt
flavour_text: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

name: Galarian Ponyta
flavour_text: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

name: Galarian Rapidash
flavour_text: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

name: Wobbuffet
flavour_text: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Snubbull
flavour_text: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

name: Granbull
flavour_text: It can make most any Pokémon run away by opening its big mouth to reveal its thick fangs.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia
flavour_text: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Gardevoir
flavour_text: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.

name: Litwick
flavour_text: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life-force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavour_text: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavour_text: It absorbs spirits, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Meloetta
flavour_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavour_text: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Gourgeist
flavour_text: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Sinistea
flavour_text: Sinistea gets into your body when you drink it, and then it steals your vitality from within. It also tastes awful.

name: Polteageist
flavour_text: These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots and pouring themselves into leftover tea.

name: Indeedee
flavour_text: This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer’s side. It predicts their actions with its psychic power and takes care of their day-to-day needs.

name: Sandshrew
flavour_text: No matter how high a place it falls from, this Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.

name: Sandslash
flavour_text: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

name: Machop
flavour_text: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

name: Machoke
flavour_text: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: Machamp
flavour_text: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.

name: Cubone
flavour_text: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

name: Meditite
flavour_text: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

name: Medicham
flavour_text: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

name: Roggenrola
flavour_text: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
flavour_text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Drilbur
flavour_text: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Tyrunt
flavour_text: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

name: Tyrantrum
flavour_text: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

name: Passimian
flavour_text: The boss chooses 10 members of the group to go out hunting. The hunting party will evenly split the food they find with the rest of the group.

name: Falinks
flavour_text: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation.

name: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon
flavour_text: In this form, it draws on the power of stone. Its body is rock-solid, protecting it from all manner of attacks.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavour_text: Deeply proud and keenly smart, this Pokémon moves with cunning during battle and relentlessly attacks enemies’ weak points.

name: Alolan Persian
flavour_text: This Pokémon is one tough opponent. Not only does it have formidable physical abilities, but it’s also not above fighting dirty.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavour_text: Alolan Grimer will gladly gobble up any kind of trash, making it a widely used and popular Pokémon at garbage disposal facilities.

name: Alolan Muk
flavour_text: What look like fangs and claws are actually crystallized poison that will afflict you at a mere touch, so don’t get too close.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavour_text: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavour_text: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavour_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Stunky
flavour_text: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

name: Skuntank
flavour_text: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

name: Spiritomb
flavour_text: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

name: Purrloin
flavour_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
flavour_text: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Scraggy
flavour_text: It will abruptly headbutt anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is extremely hard.

name: Scrafty
flavour_text: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

name: Yveltal
flavour_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Guzzlord
flavour_text: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavour_text: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavour_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Excadrill
flavour_text: Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong enough to bore through iron plates. This Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

name: Ferroseed
flavour_text: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn
flavour_text: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
flavour_text: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

name: Honedge
flavour_text: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

name: Doublade
flavour_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
flavour_text: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Bagon
flavour_text: Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is apparently the influence of information carried in its genes.

name: Shelgon
flavour_text: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

name: Salamence
flavour_text: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

name: Meowth
flavour_text: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Persian
flavour_text: It has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. This is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

name: Kangaskhan
flavour_text: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

name: Sentret
flavour_text: If it encounters a foe, it will stand up on its tail, making itself look bigger than usual to intimidate them.

name: Furret
flavour_text: It is nimble and has a very flexible body. Even if you get ahold of it, it’ll slip right out of your arms.

name: Smeargle
flavour_text: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from the tip of the tail is predetermined for each Smeargle.

name: Lugia
flavour_text: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Taillow
flavour_text: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Swellow
flavour_text: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

name: Slakoth
flavour_text: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Vigoroth
flavour_text: It is always hungry because it won’t stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can’t keep still.

name: Slaking
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives lying on its side. It only rolls over and moves when there is no more grass to eat.

name: Spinda
flavour_text: Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!

name: Tornadus
flavour_text: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Bunnelby
flavour_text: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Diggersby
flavour_text: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Furfrou
flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Tandemaus
flavour_text: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Maushold
flavour_text: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Cacnea
flavour_text: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

name: Roserade
flavour_text: The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.

name: Vivillon
flavour_text: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

name: Buzzwole
flavour_text: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Reshiram
flavour_text: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

name: Scorbunny
flavour_text: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Aurorus
flavour_text: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

name: Cramorant
flavour_text: Cramorant takes advantage of Arrokuda’s frantic thrashing to help spit Arrokuda out at high speed.

name: Minun
flavour_text: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

name: Toxel
flavour_text: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Galarian Ponyta
flavour_text: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

name: Snubbull
flavour_text: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

name: Indeedee
flavour_text: This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer’s side. It predicts their actions with its psychic power and takes care of their day-to-day needs.

name: Sandshrew
flavour_text: No matter how high a place it falls from, this Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.

name: Tyrantrum
flavour_text: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

name: Falinks
flavour_text: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation.

name: Alolan Muk
flavour_text: What look like fangs and claws are actually crystallized poison that will afflict you at a mere touch, so don’t get too close.

name: Purrloin
flavour_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Yveltal
flavour_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavour_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavour_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Salamence
flavour_text: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

name: Slakoth
flavour_text: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Meowth
flavour_text: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Tangela
flavour_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Magby
flavour_text: This Pokémon is still small and timid. Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised, flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

name: Magmar
flavour_text: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Horsea
flavour_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra
flavour_text: It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

name: Mantyke
flavour_text: It’s highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.

name: Omanyte
flavour_text: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

name: Omastar
flavour_text: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

name: Pichu
flavour_text: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavour_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Latias
flavour_text: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Latios
flavour_text: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Hitmonlee
flavour_text: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

name: Hitmonchan
flavour_text: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

name: Kabuto
flavour_text: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

name: Kabutops
flavour_text: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

name: Phanpy
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Tyrogue
flavour_text: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Tauros
flavour_text: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

name: Meloetta
flavour_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Sprigatito
flavour_text: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Floragato
flavour_text: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Tarountula
flavour_text: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Spidops
flavour_text: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

name: Nymble
flavour_text: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

name: Smoliv
flavour_text: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Dolliv
flavour_text: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
flavour_text: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Bramblin
flavour_text: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

name: Brambleghast
flavour_text: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Capsakid
flavour_text: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

name: Scovillain
flavour_text: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Rellor
flavour_text: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

name: Wo-Chien
flavour_text: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

name: Fuecoco
flavour_text: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

name: Crocalor
flavour_text: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

name: Skeledirge
flavour_text: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Charcadet
flavour_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Chi-Yu
flavour_text: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

name: Quaxly
flavour_text: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Quaxwell
flavour_text: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

name: Quaquaval
flavour_text: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

name: Wiglett
flavour_text: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

name: Wugtrio
flavour_text: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

name: Finizen
flavour_text: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Palafin
flavour_text: This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.

name: Cetoddle
flavour_text: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetitan
flavour_text: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Veluza
flavour_text: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

name: Dondozo
flavour_text: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

name: Tatsugiri
flavour_text: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Frigibax
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Arctibax
flavour_text: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

name: Baxcalibur
flavour_text: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Pawmi
flavour_text: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmo
flavour_text: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

name: Pawmot
flavour_text: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Tadbulb
flavour_text: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

name: Wattrel
flavour_text: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

name: Kilowattrel
flavour_text: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Miraidon
flavour_text: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Fidough
flavour_text: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Dachsbun
flavour_text: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: Ceruledge
flavour_text: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

name: Rabsca
flavour_text: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

name: Flittle
flavour_text: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Espathra
flavour_text: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Greavard
flavour_text: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Houndstone
flavour_text: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

name: Gimmighoul
flavour_text: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Mankey
flavour_text: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

name: Primeape
flavour_text: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

name: Annihilape
flavour_text: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavour_text: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

name: Toedscool
flavour_text: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

name: Toedscruel
flavour_text: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

name: Klawf
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

name: Ting-Lu
flavour_text: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

name: Koraidon
flavour_text: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavour_text: It’s dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.

name: Paldean Clodsire
flavour_text: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

name: Lokix
flavour_text: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

name: Maschiff
flavour_text: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Mabosstiff
flavour_text: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Shroodle
flavour_text: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

name: Grafaiai
flavour_text: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

name: Bombirdier
flavour_text: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Tinkatink
flavour_text: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatuff
flavour_text: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

name: Tinkaton
flavour_text: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Varoom
flavour_text: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom
flavour_text: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Orthworm
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Lechonk
flavour_text: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

name: Oinkologne
flavour_text: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

name: Tandemaus
flavour_text: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Maushold
flavour_text: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.

name: Squawkabilly
flavour_text: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

name: Cyclizar
flavour_text: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

name: Flamigo
flavour_text: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

name: Fuecoco
flavour_text: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

name: Greavard
flavour_text: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Gimmighoul
flavour_text: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavour_text: It’s dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.

name: Orthworm
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Maushold
flavour_text: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.

name: Sprigatito
flavour_text: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Floragato
flavour_text: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Meowscarada
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Pawmi
flavour_text: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmo
flavour_text: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

name: Pawmot
flavour_text: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Gimmighoul
flavour_text: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Tinkatink
flavour_text: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatuff
flavour_text: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

name: Gholdengo
flavour_text: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

name: Baxcalibur
flavour_text: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Scyther
flavour_text: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Pineco
flavour_text: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

name: Volbeat
flavour_text: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Illumise
flavour_text: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

name: Phantump
flavour_text: This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now wanders the forest searching for friends.

name: Trevenant
flavour_text: Trevenant is very kind to Pokémon living in the forest. It doesn’t even care if these Pokémon take up residence in the greenery on its head.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: If Charmander is healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigorously and won’t go out even if it gets a bit wet.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents to battle against. Its aggression will not be quelled if it doesn’t win.

name: Ponyta
flavour_text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Rapidash
flavour_text: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.

name: Magmar
flavour_text: Wavering flames similar to those of the sun appear on the surface of this Pokémon’s body.

name: Magmortar
flavour_text: They dwell in volcanic craters. It’s said that only a single pair of Magmortar will inhabit any given volcano.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavour_text: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Lapras
flavour_text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Piplup
flavour_text: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

name: Prinplup
flavour_text: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: Empoleon
flavour_text: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will mercilessly decimate anything that threatens the safety of its colony.

name: Phione
flavour_text: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Electabuzz
flavour_text: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

name: Electivire
flavour_text: This Pokémon presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent and instantly sends over 20,000 volts of high-voltage electricity through them.

name: Electrike
flavour_text: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Drowzee
flavour_text: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

name: Hypno
flavour_text: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Mew
flavour_text: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Spoink
flavour_text: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.

name: Grumpig
flavour_text: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes’ minds.

name: Diglett
flavour_text: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Dugtrio
flavour_text: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Groudon
flavour_text: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Hawlucha
flavour_text: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking its next victim.

name: Darkrai
flavour_text: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

name: Trubbish
flavour_text: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

name: Garbodor
flavour_text: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Zorua
flavour_text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zoroark
flavour_text: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Morpeko
flavour_text: Hunger has disrupted this Pokémon’s hormonal balance. The Electric-type energy stored in its cheek sacs has turned into Dark-type energy.

name: Forretress
flavour_text: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Kartana
flavour_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Varoom
flavour_text: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom
flavour_text: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Dratini
flavour_text: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

name: Dragonite
flavour_text: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

name: Axew
flavour_text: If you see peculiar teeth marks on boulders or trees, it means an Axew is likely living nearby.

name: Fraxure
flavour_text: Fraxure uses its thick tusks to neatly cut prey into two portions—one to eat now and one to save for later.

name: Haxorus
flavour_text: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.

name: Druddigon
flavour_text: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can’t stop touching it.

name: Miltank
flavour_text: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

name: Chatot
flavour_text: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Minccino
flavour_text: These Pokémon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
flavour_text: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.

name: Furfrou
flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Lapras
flavour_text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Empoleon
flavour_text: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will mercilessly decimate anything that threatens the safety of its colony.

name: Groudon
flavour_text: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Morpeko

name: Revavroom
flavour_text: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Miltank
flavour_text: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

name: Mew
flavour_text: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Mew
flavour_text: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Scyther
flavour_text: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Pineco
flavour_text: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

name: Phantump
flavour_text: This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now wanders the forest searching for friends.

name: Trevenant
flavour_text: Trevenant is very kind to Pokémon living in the forest. It doesn’t even care if these Pokémon take up residence in the greenery on its head.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: If Charmander is healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigorously and won’t go out even if it gets a bit wet.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents to battle against. Its aggression will not be quelled if it doesn’t win.

name: Ponyta
flavour_text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Rapidash
flavour_text: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Electrike
flavour_text: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Hawlucha

name: Gastly

name: Haunter

name: Zorua

name: Zoroark

name: Forretress
