name: Dratini
flavour_text: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

name: Dragonite
flavour_text: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

name: Axew
flavour_text: If you see peculiar teeth marks on boulders or trees, it means an Axew is likely living nearby.

name: Fraxure
flavour_text: Fraxure uses its thick tusks to neatly cut prey into two portions—one to eat now and one to save for later.

name: Haxorus
flavour_text: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.

name: Arboliva
flavour_text: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Tangela
flavour_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Tangrowth
flavour_text: Vine growth is accelerated for Tangrowth living in warm climates. If the vines grow long, Tangrowth shortens them by tearing parts of them off.

name: Heracross
flavour_text: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

name: Celebi
flavour_text: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Treecko
flavour_text: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

name: Grovyle
flavour_text: Grovyle leaps from branch to branch in large trees, moving with ease. It propels itself with astounding speed and force.

name: Sceptile
flavour_text: It agilely flits through the jungle and uses the sharp-edged leaves on its arms to cut down its prey.

name: Surskit
flavour_text: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

name: Masquerain
flavour_text: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

name: Shroomish
flavour_text: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.

name: Breloom
flavour_text: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

name: Budew
flavour_text: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.

name: Carnivine
flavour_text: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Sewaddle
flavour_text: The bumps on their heads are sensory organs. When Sewaddle meet, they greet each other by rubbing these bumps together.

name: Swadloon
flavour_text: Swadloon wraps itself in leaves for protection. It uses the two leaves atop its head to detect air movements and feel out its surroundings.

name: Leavanny
flavour_text: This gentle Pokémon has strong protective instincts. The leaves on its arms are sharp enough to slice a thick tree in half with one stroke.

name: Durant
flavour_text: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Applin
flavour_text: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.

name: Flapple
flavour_text: It uses its own body fluid to repair its apple. Strong Flapple that have won many battles have apples that are clay colored all over.

name: Numel
flavour_text: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

name: Camerupt
flavour_text: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Castform Sunny Form
flavour_text: Castform changes to this form when it basks in bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin, it feels all dried out!

name: Victini
flavour_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Tepig
flavour_text: This Pokémon is a ravenous glutton. It uses its excellent sense of smell to find food, then cooks it to a crisp before eating.

name: Pignite
flavour_text: When defending its friends, Pignite will stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong. But it’s powerless when faced with an empty stomach.

name: Emboar
flavour_text: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Darumaka
flavour_text: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
flavour_text: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

name: Larvesta
flavour_text: In ancient times, Larvesta was worshiped as the emissary of the sun. However, it was also viewed as a burden since it often caused forest fires.

name: Volcarona
flavour_text: This Pokémon scatters burning scales. Most of the danger of these scales is not in their heat—it’s in the way they rob the surrounding air of oxygen.

name: Poliwag
flavour_text: Its legs are newly grown, and it can’t walk very well. It seems to prefer swimming through the water instead.

name: Poliwhirl
flavour_text: Its skin is moist all over its body. The skin on its belly spiral also feels smooth.

name: Politoed
flavour_text: It’s the leader of Poliwag and Poliwhirl. When Politoed roars, they all cower in fear.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavour_text: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

name: Wooper
flavour_text: When it walks around on land, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

name: Quagsire
flavour_text: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on riverbed boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

name: Castform Rainy Form
flavour_text: This is Castform’s form when pelted by rain. In an experiment where it was placed in a shower, this Pokémon didn’t change to this form.

name: Castform Snowy Form
flavour_text: This is Castform’s form when caught in a hailstorm. Its whole body is chilled, and its skin is partially frozen!

name: Clamperl
flavour_text: Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder’s pearls.

name: Huntail
flavour_text: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

name: Gorebyss
flavour_text: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

name: Regice
flavour_text: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.

name: Cubchoo
flavour_text: When Cubchoo starts sneezing, watch out! If it spatters you with its frosty snot, you’ll get frostbite.

name: Beartic
flavour_text: Feared as the Snow-White Demon in northern lands, Beartic uses its frosty claws and fangs to attack prey.

name: Sobble
flavour_text: It’s a very cautious Pokémon. When it has no choice but to battle, it hides itself before attacking.

name: Drizzile
flavour_text: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it defends its home by laying traps.

name: Inteleon
flavour_text: It may present itself as being well-mannered, but deep down, it still has a lazy side. It will slack off when its Trainer isn’t looking.

name: Rapid Strike Urshifu
flavour_text: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

name: Magnemite
flavour_text: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges electromagnetic waves and so on from the units at its sides.

name: Magneton
flavour_text: They’re formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

name: Voltorb
flavour_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavour_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Chinchou
flavour_text: It shoots positively and negatively charged electricity from the tips of its two antennae and stuns its opponents.

name: Lanturn
flavour_text: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light. With the prey incapacitated, the Pokémon swallows it in a single gulp.

name: Zekrom
flavour_text: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

name: Toxel
flavour_text: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Toxtricity
flavour_text: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

name: Morpeko
flavour_text: It has a small stomach. If it isn’t constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia
flavour_text: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Espurr
flavour_text: Behind an Espurr’s expressionless face is a frantic struggle to contain psychic power.

name: Meowstic
flavour_text: If Meowstic continuously emits its powerful psychic energy, it will damage its own body.

name: Diancie
flavour_text: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.

name: Hatenna
flavour_text: It senses the feelings of other living creatures. Be careful not to expose it to strong emotions for too long, or it will end up exhausted.

name: Hattrem
flavour_text: The moment this Pokémon finds someone who’s emitting strong emotions, it will pummel them senseless with its braids to silence them.

name: Hatterene
flavour_text: Beware of forests that show no signs of living creatures within. You may have wandered into Hatterene’s territory.

name: Bramblin
flavour_text: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

name: Brambleghast
flavour_text: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Gligar
flavour_text: It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.

name: Gliscor
flavour_text: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Trapinch
flavour_text: As it digs through the sand, its giant jaws crush any rocks that obstruct its path. It builds a funnel-shaped nest.

name: Regirock
flavour_text: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

name: Bonsly
flavour_text: From its eyes, it can expel excess moisture from its body. This liquid is similar in composition to human sweat.

name: Riolu
flavour_text: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions, such as joy and rage, in the form of waves.

name: Lucario
flavour_text: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

name: Croagunk
flavour_text: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

name: Toxicroak
flavour_text: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

name: Gallade
flavour_text: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

name: Throh
flavour_text: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.

name: Sawk
flavour_text: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

name: Dwebble
flavour_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Meloetta
flavour_text: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Stufful
flavour_text: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
flavour_text: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Rolycoly
flavour_text: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon’s body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

name: Carkol
flavour_text: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

name: Coalossal
flavour_text: To intimidate its opponents, Coalossal will vigorously shake its body, scattering coal from its smoldering back.

name: Silicobra
flavour_text: Silicobra’s large nostrils are specialized for spraying sand, so this Pokémon is not very good at telling apart different smells.

name: Sandaconda
flavour_text: The sand it spews contains sharp, pointy gravel, which is actually just sand that Sandaconda’s saliva has hardened into irregular shapes.

name: Kubfu
flavour_text: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

name: Zubat
flavour_text: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun’s light won’t reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

name: Golbat
flavour_text: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

name: Crobat
flavour_text: This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully. Crobat can fly through cramped caves without needing to slow down.

name: Koffing
flavour_text: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

name: Weezing
flavour_text: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.

name: Qwilfish
flavour_text: Experienced fishers say they try to catch Qwilfish in the brief moment that these Pokémon become defenseless just after launching poisonous spikes.

name: Seviper
flavour_text: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.

name: Zorua
flavour_text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Foongus
flavour_text: This Pokémon prefers damp places. It spurts out poison spores to repel approaching enemies.

name: Amoonguss
flavour_text: Amoonguss mimics Poké Balls. It is not yet clear whether this mimicry is effective against other Pokémon.

name: Vullaby
flavour_text: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

name: Mandibuzz
flavour_text: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.

name: Inkay
flavour_text: Being upside-down improves its blood flow and clears its mind, causing the power of its psychic moves to increase dramatically.

name: Malamar
flavour_text: It flashes the luminescent spots on its body to hypnotize its opponents, gaining total control over them.

name: Single Strike Urshifu
flavour_text: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

name: Zarude
flavour_text: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Bombirdier
flavour_text: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Registeel
flavour_text: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

name: Bronzor
flavour_text: They are found in ancient tombs. The patterns on their backs are said to be imbued with mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavour_text: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

name: Pawniard
flavour_text: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Bisharp
flavour_text: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.

name: Magearna
flavour_text: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Meltan
flavour_text: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

name: Melmetal
flavour_text: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

name: Vibrava
flavour_text: It generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously vibrating its wings. After making its prey faint, it dissolves the prey with its digestive juices.

name: Chansey
flavour_text: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Blissey
flavour_text: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Dunsparce
flavour_text: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

name: Teddiursa
flavour_text: Its paws are soaked in oodles of honey. When nervous, Teddiursa will lick its paws and soon have a smile back on its face.

name: Ursaring
flavour_text: It is quite skilled at climbing trees. If it comes across a Primeape while searching for berries in the treetops, trouble will surely ensue.

name: Castform
flavour_text: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

name: Regigigas
flavour_text: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Patrat
flavour_text: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Watchog
flavour_text: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Lillipup
flavour_text: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

name: Herdier
flavour_text: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

name: Stoutland
flavour_text: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

name: Audino
flavour_text: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

name: Minccino
flavour_text: These Pokémon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
flavour_text: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.

name: Furfrou
flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Rookidee
flavour_text: The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee’s wings, it’ll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

name: Corvisquire
flavour_text: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

name: Treecko
flavour_text: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

name: Grovyle
flavour_text: Grovyle leaps from branch to branch in large trees, moving with ease. It propels itself with astounding speed and force.

name: Shroomish
flavour_text: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.

name: Budew
flavour_text: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.

name: Flapple
flavour_text: It uses its own body fluid to repair its apple. Strong Flapple that have won many battles have apples that are clay colored all over.

name: Tepig
flavour_text: This Pokémon is a ravenous glutton. It uses its excellent sense of smell to find food, then cooks it to a crisp before eating.

name: Quagsire
flavour_text: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on riverbed boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

name: Zekrom
flavour_text: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

name: Morpeko
flavour_text: It has a small stomach. If it isn’t constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

name: Meowstic
flavour_text: If Meowstic continuously emits its powerful psychic energy, it will damage its own body.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.

name: Brambleghast
flavour_text: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Bonsly
flavour_text: From its eyes, it can expel excess moisture from its body. This liquid is similar in composition to human sweat.

name: Riolu
flavour_text: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions, such as joy and rage, in the form of waves.

name: Meloetta
flavour_text: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Carkol
flavour_text: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

name: Kubfu
flavour_text: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

name: Seviper
flavour_text: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.

name: Zorua
flavour_text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Malamar
flavour_text: It flashes the luminescent spots on its body to hypnotize its opponents, gaining total control over them.

name: Bisharp
flavour_text: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.

name: Meltan
flavour_text: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

name: Castform
flavour_text: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

name: Cinccino
flavour_text: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.

name: Sobble
flavour_text: It’s a very cautious Pokémon. When it has no choice but to battle, it hides itself before attacking.

name: Cottonee
flavour_text: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Torchic
flavour_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Combusken
flavour_text: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Blaziken
flavour_text: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

name: Frillish
flavour_text: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Jellicent
flavour_text: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Onix
flavour_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Zubat
flavour_text: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun’s light won’t reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

name: Golbat
flavour_text: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

name: Crobat
flavour_text: This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully. Crobat can fly through cramped caves without needing to slow down.

name: Grimer
flavour_text: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: Muk
flavour_text: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.

name: Absol
flavour_text: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Skrelp
flavour_text: This Pokémon is a poor swimmer. If it’s caught in a fierce storm, it will sometimes get washed far away and become unable to return to its home.

name: Steelix
flavour_text: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Chansey
flavour_text: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Blissey
flavour_text: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.

name: Porygon
flavour_text: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2
flavour_text: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

name: Porygon-Z
flavour_text: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.

name: Celebi
flavour_text: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Bombirdier
flavour_text: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Surskit
flavour_text: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

name: Masquerain
flavour_text: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

name: Brute Bonnet
flavour_text: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Slither Wing
flavour_text: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

name: Iron Moth
flavour_text: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

name: Psyduck
flavour_text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

name: Golduck
flavour_text: It swims gracefully along on the quiet, slow- moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

name: Vaporeon
flavour_text: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away into water.

name: Buizel
flavour_text: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

name: Floatzel
flavour_text: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and help fishers carry what they caught.

name: Snom
flavour_text: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

name: Frosmoth
flavour_text: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.

name: Pawmi
flavour_text: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmo
flavour_text: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

name: Pawmot
flavour_text: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Iron Hands
flavour_text: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Thorns
flavour_text: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

name: Espeon
flavour_text: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.

name: Flittle
flavour_text: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Espathra
flavour_text: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Greavard
flavour_text: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Houndstone
flavour_text: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

name: Scream Tail
flavour_text: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

name: Iron Valiant
flavour_text: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Leaves
flavour_text: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

name: Iron Boulder
flavour_text: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Iron Crown
flavour_text: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

name: Nacli
flavour_text: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

name: Naclstack
flavour_text: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Garganacl
flavour_text: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

name: Great Tusk
flavour_text: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

name: Sandy Shocks
flavour_text: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

name: Umbreon
flavour_text: When darkness falls, the rings on the body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

name: Sneasel
flavour_text: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

name: Weavile
flavour_text: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Sableye
flavour_text: Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.

name: Pawniard
flavour_text: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

name: Bisharp
flavour_text: It’s accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

name: Kingambit
flavour_text: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

name: Glimmet
flavour_text: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Glimmora
flavour_text: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Iron Jugulis
flavour_text: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

name: Roaring Moon
flavour_text: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

name: Corviknight
flavour_text: Although its wings have partly turned to steel and become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies through the skies with ease.

name: Cufant
flavour_text: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

name: Copperajah
flavour_text: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.

name: Iron Treads
flavour_text: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

name: Altaria
flavour_text: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Walking Wake
flavour_text: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

name: Gouging Fire
flavour_text: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

name: Raging Bolt
flavour_text: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou’s ancestor.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Girafarig
flavour_text: Girafarig’s tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.

name: Farigiraf
flavour_text: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

name: Dunsparce
flavour_text: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

name: Dudunsparce
flavour_text: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

name: Swablu
flavour_text: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Rufflet
flavour_text: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

name: Braviary
flavour_text: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

name: Hawlucha
flavour_text: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.

name: Rookidee
flavour_text: The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee’s wings, it’ll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

name: Corvisquire
flavour_text: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

name: Flamigo
flavour_text: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

name: Snom
flavour_text: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

name: Flittle
flavour_text: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Iron Boulder
flavour_text: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Glimmora
flavour_text: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Raging Bolt
flavour_text: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou’s ancestor.

name: Hawlucha
flavour_text: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.

name: Rellor
flavour_text: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

name: Charcadet
flavour_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Tadbulb
flavour_text: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

name: Rabsca
flavour_text: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

name: Diglett
flavour_text: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Dugtrio
flavour_text: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Klawf
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

name: Orthworm
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Swablu
flavour_text: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Altaria
flavour_text: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Iron Valiant
flavour_text: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

name: Roaring Moon
flavour_text: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

name: Caterpie
flavour_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
flavour_text: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
flavour_text: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Cacnea
flavour_text: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

name: Tropius
flavour_text: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

name: Petilil
flavour_text: If the leaves on its head are pruned with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

name: Hisuian Lilligant
flavour_text: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Vulpix
flavour_text: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales
flavour_text: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It’s very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Psyduck
flavour_text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

name: Goldeen
flavour_text: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Seaking
flavour_text: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

name: Feebas
flavour_text: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.

name: Snorunt
flavour_text: It is said that a home visited by a Snorunt will prosper. It can withstand cold of −150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Froslass
flavour_text: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Luvdisc
flavour_text: During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

name: Piplup
flavour_text: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

name: Iron Bundle
flavour_text: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Emolga
flavour_text: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Yamper
flavour_text: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Slowbro
flavour_text: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

name: Munna
flavour_text: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

name: Musharna
flavour_text: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

name: Sylveon
flavour_text: Sylveon cuts an elegant figure as it dances lightly around, feelers fluttering, but its piercing moves aim straight for its opponents’ weak spots.

name: Carbink
flavour_text: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

name: Enamorus
flavour_text: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon’s love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Fidough
flavour_text: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Flutter Mane
flavour_text: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Wooper
flavour_text: When it walks around on land, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

name: Quagsire
flavour_text: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon travels in a pack with others until it grows up. When its mood turns sour, it starts striking the ground with the rocks on its neck.

name: Sandygast
flavour_text: It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to close in on them while they’re blinded, but since Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.

name: Palossand
flavour_text: From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones of its victims, which are all dried up after being drained of their vitality.

name: Cacturne
flavour_text: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.

name: Spiritomb
flavour_text: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

name: Scraggy
flavour_text: It will abruptly headbutt anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is extremely hard.

name: Scrafty
flavour_text: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

name: Mareanie
flavour_text: It has excellent regenerative capabilities. Legs that a Mareanie has lost have a very bitter, astringent flavor—they’re not suitable as food.

name: Toxapex
flavour_text: Toxapex gets into fierce battles with Bruxish over areas where warm ocean currents flow, but the odds are always against it.

name: Goomy
flavour_text: Goomy’s horns are excellent sensory organs that cover all five of Goomy’s senses. Goomy picks up on danger from the movement of the air.

name: Hisuian Sliggoo
flavour_text: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui’s water.

name: Hisuian Goodra
flavour_text: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can’t stop touching it.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Munchlax
flavour_text: When it is voraciously gulping down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Snorlax
flavour_text: Its stomach’s digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn’t bother it at all.

name: Teddiursa
flavour_text: Its paws are soaked in oodles of honey. When nervous, Teddiursa will lick its paws and soon have a smile back on its face.

name: Ursaring
flavour_text: It is quite skilled at climbing trees. If it comes across a Primeape while searching for berries in the treetops, trouble will surely ensue.

name: Ursaluna
flavour_text: I believe it was Hisui’s swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Hisuian Zorua
flavour_text: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Furfrou
flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Skwovet
flavour_text: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

name: Greedent
flavour_text: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Vulpix
flavour_text: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Piplup
flavour_text: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Sylveon

name: Mareanie

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

name: Caterpie
flavour_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
flavour_text: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
flavour_text: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Mareep
flavour_text: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Flaaffy
flavour_text: Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

name: Ampharos
flavour_text: When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean’s surface.

name: Slowbro
flavour_text: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

name: Kangaskhan
flavour_text: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

name: Ditto
flavour_text: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.

name: Snorlax
flavour_text: Its stomach’s digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn’t bother it at all.

name: Munchlax
flavour_text: When it is voraciously gulping down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Wurmple
flavour_text: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Silcoon
flavour_text: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

name: Beautifly
flavour_text: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.

name: Cascoon
flavour_text: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Dustox
flavour_text: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

name: Lileep
flavour_text: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

name: Cradily
flavour_text: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

name: Kricketot
flavour_text: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Kricketune
flavour_text: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Combee
flavour_text: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers nectar from flowers to please Vespiquen.

name: Karrablast
flavour_text: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

name: Shelmet
flavour_text: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

name: Accelgor
flavour_text: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Dhelmise
flavour_text: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

name: Pheromosa
flavour_text: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

name: Poltchageist
flavour_text: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha
flavour_text: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home’s floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Teal MaskOgerpon
flavour_text: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Ponyta
flavour_text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Rapidash
flavour_text: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.

name: Flareon
flavour_text: It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Moltres
flavour_text: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Cyndaquil
flavour_text: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

name: Quilava
flavour_text: The fur covering this Pokémon’s body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.

name: Houndour
flavour_text: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Houndoom
flavour_text: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Heatmor
flavour_text: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Psyduck
flavour_text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

name: Golduck
flavour_text: It swims gracefully along on the quiet, slow- moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

name: Staryu
flavour_text: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

name: Starmie
flavour_text: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

name: Carvanha
flavour_text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Wailmer
flavour_text: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Spheal
flavour_text: As it drifts among the waves, Spheal probes the sea. As soon as it spots prey, it informs the Walrein in its herd.

name: Sealeo
flavour_text: This Pokémon has a habit of spinning round things on its nose, whether those things are Poké Balls or Spheal.

name: Walrein
flavour_text: Walrein’s tusks keep growing throughout its life. Tusks broken in battle will grow back to their usual impressive size in a year.

name: Kyogre
flavour_text: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Oshawott
flavour_text: It’s said that Oshawott learned to maintain its scalchop with riverbed stones by mimicking humans it saw using whetstones.

name: Dewott
flavour_text: Dewott has a studious and stern personality. It masters the use of its scalchops through dedicated, repeated training.

name: Samurott
flavour_text: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.

name: Alomomola
flavour_text: They float upon the open sea. Many water Pokémon gather in the area around Alomomola.

name: Dewpider
flavour_text: It supports the water bubble that envelops its head with three of its legs. Sometimes it secretly swaps which legs are holding up the bubble.

name: Araquanid
flavour_text: It launches sticky water bubbles. Foes who lose consciousness while trapped inside these bubbles will get torn apart by Araquanid’s gnashing jaws.

name: Bruxish
flavour_text: When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around sparkles brilliantly.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Shinx
flavour_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavour_text: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

name: Luxray
flavour_text: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

name: Pachirisu
flavour_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Tynamo
flavour_text: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

name: Eelektrik
flavour_text: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
flavour_text: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

name: Thundurus
flavour_text: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

name: Helioptile
flavour_text: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Wattrel
flavour_text: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

name: Kilowattrel
flavour_text: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

name: Clefable
flavour_text: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Drowzee
flavour_text: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

name: Hypno
flavour_text: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Mime Jr.
flavour_text: It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancer and carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s steps like an apprentice.

name: Mr. Mime
flavour_text: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

name: Mewtwo
flavour_text: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia
flavour_text: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Chimecho
flavour_text: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

name: Wynaut
flavour_text: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Woobat
flavour_text: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

name: Swoobat
flavour_text: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

name: Hoopa
flavour_text: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

name: Makuhita
flavour_text: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama
flavour_text: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Anorith
flavour_text: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

name: Armaldo
flavour_text: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

name: Groudon
flavour_text: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Drilbur
flavour_text: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
flavour_text: Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong enough to bore through iron plates. This Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

name: Timburr
flavour_text: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr
flavour_text: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr
flavour_text: Rather than rely on their strength, they master moves that make good use of centrifugal force to swing around concrete.

name: Minior
flavour_text: It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color of its core is said to be determined by the composition of the dust it eats.

name: Grimer
flavour_text: When two of these Pokémon’s bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.

name: Muk
flavour_text: It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

name: Poochyena
flavour_text: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

name: Mightyena
flavour_text: Once it’s caught the scent of faraway prey, the leader gives a signal, and the whole pack moves out.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavour_text: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavour_text: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavour_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Gulpin
flavour_text: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

name: Swalot
flavour_text: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

name: Absol
flavour_text: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Vullaby
flavour_text: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

name: Mandibuzz
flavour_text: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.

name: Skarmory
flavour_text: Since the feathers that it sheds are thin and sharp, people apparently once used them as swords.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Beldum
flavour_text: All its cells are magnets. It communicates with others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces from its body.

name: Metang
flavour_text: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

name: Metagross
flavour_text: It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then Metagross uses the mouth on its stomach to chew its prey to bits.

name: Escavalier
flavour_text: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

name: Genesect
flavour_text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Duraludon
flavour_text: Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.

name: Archaludon
flavour_text: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

name: Varoom
flavour_text: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom
flavour_text: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Dratini
flavour_text: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

name: Dragonite
flavour_text: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

name: Rayquaza
flavour_text: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

name: Noibat
flavour_text: Noibat can change the frequency of its sound waves at will, and it generates ultrasonic waves of up to 200,000 hertz.

name: Noivern
flavour_text: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

name: Turtonator
flavour_text: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Drampa
flavour_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Applin
flavour_text: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.

name: Dipplin
flavour_text: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Hydrapple
flavour_text: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

name: Cyclizar
flavour_text: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

name: Rattata
flavour_text: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

name: Raticate
flavour_text: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Aipom
flavour_text: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavour_text: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things that Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

name: Skitty
flavour_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavour_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Kecleon
flavour_text: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can’t make its belly pattern disappear, however.

name: Pidove
flavour_text: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

name: Tranquill
flavour_text: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

name: Unfezant
flavour_text: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

name: Ducklett
flavour_text: It strengthens its body by diving into the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.

name: Furfrou
flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Type: Null
flavour_text: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Silvally
flavour_text: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Wurmple
flavour_text: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Lileep
flavour_text: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

name: Kricketune
flavour_text: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Accelgor
flavour_text: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Ponyta
flavour_text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Wattrel
flavour_text: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Wynaut
flavour_text: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

flavour_text: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

flavour_text: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

name: Raticate
