name: Aipom
flavour_text: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavour_text: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

name: Mudkip
flavour_text: When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its small size.

name: Marshtomp
flavour_text: It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents that are bogged down and unable to move.

name: Swampert
flavour_text: Swampert’s arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down Swampert’s foes. This Pokémon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

name: Electabuzz
flavour_text: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

name: Plusle
flavour_text: This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its body to create noises.

name: Minun
flavour_text: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

name: Mr. Mime
flavour_text: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

name: Mewtwo
flavour_text: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

name: Roggenrola
flavour_text: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
flavour_text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Falinks
flavour_text: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation.

name: Koffing
flavour_text: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

name: Weezing
flavour_text: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavour_text: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavour_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Rattata
flavour_text: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

name: Raticate
flavour_text: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

name: Smeargle
flavour_text: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from the tip of the tail is predetermined for each Smeargle.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

name: Volbeat
flavour_text: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Illumise
flavour_text: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

name: Snivy
flavour_text: It prefers to avoid groups. In its day-to-day life, it dexterously controls its vines to compensate for its short arms.

name: Servine
flavour_text: Servine’s one weakness is its inflated sense of pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to cooperate with other Pokémon.

name: Serperior
flavour_text: An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance have caused this Pokémon to be known as the Lord of the Forest.

name: Team Rocket's Magmar
flavour_text: Wavering flames similar to those of the sun appear on the surface of this Pokémon’s body.

name: Team Rocket's Houndour
flavour_text: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Team Rocket's Houndoom
flavour_text: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Fennekin
flavour_text: Twigs make for Fennekin’s snacks. When it nibbles on twigs, it finds the courage to face strong foes.

name: Braixen
flavour_text: Braixen’s branch ignites as it’s pulled from the Pokémon’s tail. Braixen then uses the flame to spark powerful attacks.

name: Delphox
flavour_text: It controls flames telekinetically, trapping its foes in a fiery vortex surpassing 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit and burning them to a crisp.

name: Team Rocket's Lapras
flavour_text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Wingull
flavour_text: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

name: Pelipper
flavour_text: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

name: Hisuian Basculin
flavour_text: Its ecology is starkly different from that of other Basculin, so theories that it’s a totally different species have gained traction in recent years.

name: Hisuian Basculegion
flavour_text: It can jump with incredible power. Parts of its body are tinged red by the rage of its fallen friends.

name: Team Rocket's Voltorb
flavour_text: It’s usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Team Rocket's Electrode
flavour_text: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of the Bomb Ball.

name: Blitzle
flavour_text: This Pokémon prefers places with lots of lightning strikes. It catches lightning with its mane and stores the electricity within its body.

name: Zebstrika
flavour_text: Once the herd hears thunder, it chases after the storm clouds so that the Blitzle in the group can use the lightning to charge up.

name: Team Rocket's Pincurchin
flavour_text: This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.

name: Team Rocket's Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Team Rocket's Drowzee
flavour_text: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

name: Team Rocket's Hypno
flavour_text: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Team Rocket's Mr. Mime
flavour_text: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

name: Team Rocket's Mewtwo
flavour_text: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

name: Espurr
flavour_text: Behind an Espurr’s expressionless face is a frantic struggle to contain psychic power.

name: Meowstic
flavour_text: When they sense danger, they exert their psychic power at its maximum output. They have no regard for their opponents.

name: Oranguru
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer and longer as Oranguru ages.

name: Gimmighoul
flavour_text: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Cubone
flavour_text: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

name: Marowak
flavour_text: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Landorus
flavour_text: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Team Rocket's Ekans
flavour_text: A very common sight in grasslands and such. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

name: Team Rocket's Arbok
flavour_text: This Pokémon is very tenacious. Once it targets its prey, it won’t give up the chase, no matter how far the prey goes.

name: Team Rocket's Grimer
flavour_text: When two of these Pokémon’s bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.

name: Team Rocket's Muk
flavour_text: It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

name: Team Rocket's Koffing
flavour_text: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air. That’s why it’s always slightly airborne.

name: Team Rocket's Sneasel
flavour_text: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

name: Togedemaru
flavour_text: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Cufant
flavour_text: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

name: Copperajah
flavour_text: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.

name: Team Rocket's Tinkatink
flavour_text: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

name: Team Rocket's Tinkatuff
flavour_text: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

name: Team Rocket's Tinkaton
flavour_text: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Gholdengo
flavour_text: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Gible
flavour_text: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

name: Gabite
flavour_text: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

name: Garchomp
flavour_text: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

name: Duraludon
flavour_text: Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.

name: Archaludon
flavour_text: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

name: Regidrago
flavour_text: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

name: Team Rocket's Rattata
flavour_text: With their strong capacity for survival, they can live in dirty places without concern. Left unchecked, their numbers multiply rapidly.

name: Team Rocket's Meowth
flavour_text: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Team Rocket's Persian
flavour_text: It has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. This is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

name: Team Rocket's Kecleon
flavour_text: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can’t make its belly pattern disappear, however.

name: Happiny
flavour_text: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

name: Furfrou
flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Lechonk
flavour_text: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

name: Oinkologne
flavour_text: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

name: Delphox
flavour_text: It controls flames telekinetically, trapping its foes in a fiery vortex surpassing 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit and burning them to a crisp.

name: Team Rocket's Hypno
flavour_text: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Team Rocket's Tinkaton
flavour_text: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Team Rocket's Kecleon
flavour_text: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can’t make its belly pattern disappear, however.

name: Happiny
flavour_text: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

name: Lechonk
flavour_text: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

name: Vulpix
flavour_text: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales
flavour_text: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Goldeen
flavour_text: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Seaking
flavour_text: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

name: Toxel
flavour_text: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Sinistea
flavour_text: Sinistea gets into your body when you drink it, and then it steals your vitality from within. It also tastes awful.

name: Polteageist
flavour_text: These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots and pouring themselves into leftover tea.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Taillow
flavour_text: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Swellow
flavour_text: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

name: Gholdengo
flavour_text: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Mewtwo
flavour_text: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

name: Chansey
flavour_text: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Meowth
flavour_text: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Butterfree
flavour_text: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Mankey
flavour_text: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Venusaur
flavour_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Greninja
flavour_text: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Onix
flavour_text: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Magnemite
flavour_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Snivy
flavour_text: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

name: Volcarona
flavour_text: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

name: Blastoise
flavour_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Cinccino
flavour_text: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Piplup
flavour_text: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

name: Turtwig
flavour_text: It uses its whole body to photosynthesize when exposed to sunlight. Its shell is made from hardened soil.

name: Electivire
flavour_text: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

name: Misdreavus
flavour_text: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Skarmory
flavour_text: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

name: Chimchar
flavour_text: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.

name: Togepi
flavour_text: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Cherrim
flavour_text: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It’s full of energy while it’s like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Nosepass
flavour_text: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it’s in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

name: Gible
flavour_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Staraptor
flavour_text: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Manaphy
flavour_text: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Snorlax
flavour_text: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Cyclizar
flavour_text: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: Sprigatito
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floatzel
flavour_text: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Pawmot
flavour_text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Machamp
flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Ekans
flavour_text: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Bidoof
flavour_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Pachirisu
flavour_text: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

name: Riolu
flavour_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Exeggcute
flavour_text: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Froakie
flavour_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Farfetch'd
flavour_text: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Rayquaza
flavour_text: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Mimikyu
flavour_text: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Cosmog
flavour_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn’t seem to care.

name: Lycanroc
flavour_text: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavour_text: Blazing sunlight has brought out the true form and powers of this Pokémon.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavour_text: A deity resides in the snowy mountains where this Pokémon lives. In ancient times, it was worshiped as that deity’s incarnation.

name: Crabrawler
flavour_text: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavour_text: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola’s waste-disposal site. They’re all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

name: Toucannon
flavour_text: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

name: Zeraora
flavour_text: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Kartana
flavour_text: This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Blacephalon
flavour_text: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Xurkitree
flavour_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Dawn Wings Necrozma
flavour_text: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.

name: Dusk Mane Necrozma
flavour_text: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

name: Stakataka
flavour_text: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Poipole
flavour_text: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Stufful
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Vanillite
flavour_text: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

name: Jolteon
flavour_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Alcremie
flavour_text: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Audino
flavour_text: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

name: Togedemaru
flavour_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Greedent
flavour_text: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Cleffa
flavour_text: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.

name: Horsea
flavour_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Chinchou
flavour_text: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

name: Houndoom
flavour_text: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: Kangaskhan
flavour_text: Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

name: Marill
flavour_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Weavile
flavour_text: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Latias
flavour_text: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Tropius
flavour_text: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Poliwag
flavour_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

name: Milotic
flavour_text: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Zorua
flavour_text: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavour_text: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.

name: Miltank
flavour_text: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it’s been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

name: Phanpy
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Mimikyu
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Machamp
flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Regigigas
flavour_text: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Shaymin
flavour_text: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Absol
flavour_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Petilil
flavour_text: If the leaves on its head are pruned with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

name: Froakie
flavour_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Luxray
flavour_text: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

name: Pidgey
flavour_text: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

name: Torchic
flavour_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Psyduck
flavour_text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

name: Drifblim
flavour_text: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can’t be a fixed destination.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Ditto
flavour_text: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.

name: Arcanine
flavour_text: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.

name: Magikarp
flavour_text: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Mareep
flavour_text: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Krookodile
flavour_text: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

name: Swablu
flavour_text: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Heliolisk
flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Onix
flavour_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Hawlucha
flavour_text: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.

name: Genesect
flavour_text: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Jirachi
flavour_text: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Mudkip
flavour_text: When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its small size.

name: Plusle
flavour_text: This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its body to create noises.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Tornadus
flavour_text: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Cinderace
flavour_text: Using a ball that it made out of flames, Cinderace blinds its opponents and keeps them at bay.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavour_text: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

name: Quaxly
flavour_text: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Smoliv
flavour_text: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Charcadet
flavour_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Tatsugiri
flavour_text: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Frigibax
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Tinkaton
flavour_text: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Pawmi
flavour_text: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Paldean Clodsire
flavour_text: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Electrike
flavour_text: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Varoom
flavour_text: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Haxorus
flavour_text: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.

name: Chatot
flavour_text: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can’t stop touching it.

name: Victini
flavour_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Meloetta
flavour_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Zygarde
flavour_text: Born when around 10% of Zygarde’s cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

name: Zygarde
flavour_text: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Castform Sunny Form
flavour_text: Castform changes to this form when it basks in bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin, it feels all dried out!

name: Tepig
flavour_text: This Pokémon is a ravenous glutton. It uses its excellent sense of smell to find food, then cooks it to a crisp before eating.

name: Dwebble
flavour_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Zarude
flavour_text: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Treecko
flavour_text: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

name: Gallade
flavour_text: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

name: Charcadet
flavour_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Vaporeon
flavour_text: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away into water.

name: Pawniard
flavour_text: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

name: Dudunsparce
flavour_text: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

name: Floragato
flavour_text: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Sableye
flavour_text: Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.

name: Psyduck
flavour_text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

name: Feebas
flavour_text: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.

name: Froslass
flavour_text: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Quagsire
flavour_text: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on riverbed boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

name: Hisuian Zorua
flavour_text: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It’s very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Emolga
flavour_text: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Celebi
flavour_text: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Carvanha
flavour_text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Noivern
flavour_text: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

name: Skitty
flavour_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Pachirisu
flavour_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Beldum
flavour_text: All its cells are magnets. It communicates with others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces from its body.

name: Team Rocket's Scyther
flavour_text: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Team Rocket's Lapras
flavour_text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Wingull
flavour_text: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

name: Team Rocket's Wobbuffet
flavour_text: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Marowak
flavour_text: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Fennekin
flavour_text: Twigs make for Fennekin’s snacks. When it nibbles on twigs, it finds the courage to face strong foes.

name: Meowstic
flavour_text: When they sense danger, they exert their psychic power at its maximum output. They have no regard for their opponents.
